snippet.title: Idle Game "Typing Farmer" Demo is now playable！
snippet.description:
We desire a desktop idle game that costs no extra effort—and lo and behold, Typing Farmer was born!
- A Farm Goes Hand in Hand with Your Work!
Just launch the game. As you work, every keyboard stroke and mouse click will turn into growth of the crops on your farm and  fish that the little cat catches in the pond. No need for deliberate gameplay, and no need to worry about the farm in the bottom right corner distracting you. As long as you’re studying or working, your farm will be automatically cultivated!
- Harvest the Fruits of Your Hard Work After Finishing Tasks!
When you wrap up your work or study tasks, return to your farm and open the Storage—you’ll be greeted by the bountiful fruits accumulated through your diligence! The built-in statistics feature records every keyboard press and mouse click you make throughout the day. We hope that these stats, provide you a profound sense of achievement and satisfaction by showing that your hard work has been seen and rewarded. Your farm remembers every bit of your effort!
- Earn Coins and Unlock New Species!
Sell your harvested crops to earn coins and unlock a wider variety of cultivable plants. Once you’ve stockpiled a certain amount of product in the storage, you’ll attract all kinds of cute little animals to settle on your farm. Let these new species adorn your farm and accompany you through heartwarming, healing moments!
- Plan Your Schedule with the To-Do List!
The game comes with a built-in to-do list function. With just a click, you can track the time spent on each task. This statistics feature visually displays how you have used your time, allowing you to manage your daily life just like nurturing a character in a simulation game!
- Stay Focused with the Pomodoro Timer and Ambient Sounds!
We offer a customizable Pomodoro timer. Moreover, it can be combinedwith soft, soothing ambient sounds to help you immerse yourself more deeply in work and study, blocking out distractions and boosting your productivity!
- Purchase props and decorate your farm!
Once you have accumulated enough gold, click the Renovation button at the bottom of the farm screen to enter Renovation Mode. You can use gold to change the preset designs of the UI entrances (such as the Storage, Shop, Mailbox, etc.), or purchase decorative items from the Shop.
